name: Ishi
overview: Ishi was a male head of households from the tribe of Manasseh, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:23-24. His role as a leader among the families of Manasseh highlights his importance within this tribal context. There are no additional notes concerning his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Ishi means 'G-d has saved,' reflecting a meaningful Hebrew name, though it was not given directly by God. This proper name underscores a theological affirmation consistent with God's saving power.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Ishi as a descendant of Manasseh, linking him genealogically to this significant tribe of Israel. Beyond this, no further family relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ishi's significance lies in his leadership as a head of households within the tribe of Manasseh, indicating a position of responsibility and governance among God's people. His mention in 1 Chronicles situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribal organization and God's providential care over His chosen lineage.
